boundaries.host_publication_ingestion: All codes are existing RuntimeError diagnostics. Four read_bundle_bytes refusals are saved as result.reason by freeze_run_bundle. Others raise and preserve one-shot/unknown behavior.
boundaries.host_mediation_store: invoke(bundle_freeze) catches all freezer exceptions as state=unknown,resent=false. Frozen status returns confirmed; refused status returns rejected,error=reason. Only the four saved refusal codes are exported unchanged. There is no new node or graph route.
boundaries.bundle_stage: BundleIngestError from frozen input read becomes frozen_bundle_invalid; baseline read becomes baseline_bundle_invalid.
boundaries.verified_stage: Admission exceptions are collapsed to stage_binding_invalid; no raw ingestion code is exposed here.
boundaries.verifier: Live binding read failure after verification becomes status=unknown,error_class=run_binding_changed. scan_once omits failed attempts. No automatic redispatch.

catalogue_gap: The four exported refusal codes lacked shared descriptions before C2. Added entries document byte refusal, not Git verification or push outcome. The remaining internal diagnostics are explicitly classified; no unrelated catalogue policy is changed.
